raw: {"status": "NO_PLAN", "reasons": ["CS2109S prerequisite requires MA1511/MA1512/MA1521/MA2002/MA1102R/MA1312/MA1507/MA1505. The student has completed MA1521 and MA1522, but MA1521 alone is insufficient as the prerequisite is a group condition (MA1521 OR others) combined with another group. Specifically, CS2109S requires (YSC2229 or CS2040S...) AND ((MA1511 and MA1512) or MA1521 or ...). The student has MA1521, so the math part is satisfied. However, the student is in Y2S2 (Semester 4) and states 'I must take CS2109S in Y2S2'. CS2109S is offered in Sem 1 and Sem 2. So it can be taken in Sem 4. But the student also says 'CS2106 has to be in semester 6' and 'CS2109S and CS2105 must be in the same semester'. If CS2109S is in Sem 4, CS2105 must be in Sem 4. CS2105 prerequisite is YSC2229 or CS2040S... The student has CS2040S, so CS2105 is eligible in Sem 4. However, the student says 'At most 2 modules per semester' and 'In semester 5 I can only take 1 module'. The remaining modules are CS3210, CS2102, CS3219, CS3230. CS3210 prereq: CS2100 (completed). CS2102 prereq: CS1231S (completed) and CS2030S/CS2040S (completed). CS3219 prereq: CS2103T (completed). CS3230 prereq: CS2040S (completed) and CS1231S (completed). So all are eligible. Constraints: CS2109S/CS2105 in same sem. CS2106 in Sem 6. CS3210 before CS2102. CS2102 before CS2106 (so CS2102 in Sem 4 or 5). CS3219 as early as possible. Max 2 mods/sem, Sem 5 max 1. Student must take CS2109S in Y2S2 (Sem 4). So Sem 4 has CS2109S and CS2105. That's 2 mods. Sem 5 max 1 mod. Remaining: CS3210, CS2102, CS3219, CS3230, CS2106. CS2106 is fixed in Sem 6. CS2102 must be before CS2106, so CS2102 in Sem 4, 5. Sem 4 is full. So CS2102 must be in Sem 5. Sem 5 has CS2102 (1 mod). Remaining: CS3210, CS3219, CS3230 for Sem 7, 8. CS3210 must be before CS2102. CS2102 is in Sem 5. So CS3210 must be in Sem 4 or earlier. Sem 4 is full (CS2109S, CS2105). Sem 1-3 are past. Thus, CS3210 cannot be taken before CS2102. This violates the constraint 'CS3210 must come before CS2102'."]
